items.title: Joe Harris Interview, 1961-04-12
items.q: The first band I played with, the big band I played was Henry Harden.

ctx.x: George, do you remember the first band you played with?
The first band I played with, the big band I played was Henry Harden.
And the little band. You played the band before Henry Harden. Kid Clayton. Yeah, because you was playing some saxophones and you was playing Henry Harden.
